description: Read a project folder and return a GO or NO-GO verdict with each production problem, where it is, and how to fix it. Runs locally and changes no files.

path.description: Absolute path of the project folder to check. Defaults to the server's working directory.

name: sigship_check

accepted.description: Accepted risks from sigship-accept.json. They do not count for the verdict.

findings.description: Worst first, one entry per check that found something.

count.description: How many places this check found.

more.description: How many places are not listed in where.

severity.description: 1 and 2 block launch; 3 blocks only with strict.

detail.description: What was found there, with any secret value hidden.

fixPrompt.description: The fixes as one brief, worded for the connected client.

since.description: Compared with the last run of the same folder on this machine. Null on the first run.

summary.description: One line: the verdict, the counts and what changed since the last run.

verdictText.description: The verdict in words, for example "GO with 1 accepted risk".
